items.title: Joanne Brackeen interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 10, 2001
items.q: Dion Parsons is new but he’s a friend of Ira’s, so he’s been working with me for about a year.

ctx.x: Is it possible to keep a band together these days?

Well you know what you do, or what I do is, you kind of have multiple bands. You find people, maybe two or three people that are really into your music on each instrument. Because people are working in so many different groups and we travel so much, so it’s really great when you’ve got your key people there. But I try to have maybe two people on each instrument, maybe a third. Then if one’s not available, they kind of know the vocabulary. Because outside of that it wouldn’t work. I’m even going to Tel Aviv next…
Do you find it different overseas as far as the audience for your music?
